conventions.rule: A Gram-negative envelope shows, from outside in: outer membrane, thin peptidoglycan layer in the periplasm, inner membrane.
conventions.source: Madigan et al., Brock Biology of Microorganisms, 16th ed., ch. 2

rules.rule: A Gram-positive wall has a thick peptidoglycan layer and no outer membrane.
rules.source: Madigan et al., Brock Biology of Microorganisms, 16th ed., ch. 2

test_page.content: The envelope of a Gram-negative rod, labelled layer by layer from the outer membrane to the cytoplasm.
